scope: Geographic view registration only, before fit is disclosed. Coordinates anchored to the fixed AEB outline, not its elevation points. This is not a claim that the footprint or any generic façade is exact in the field.
acceptance: Always preserve original footprint/ground/other geometry and exact original flags. Compare at fixed pose/light, building ID mask plus anti-alias border. Inspect supported roof texture, exposed parapet or section boundaries, visually inappropriate repetitive high-rise overlap, and believable base contact. No claim of marked texture, materials or identity without an independently verified source. No geometry use at far tier unless independently tested.
